ayahs.translation_bn: যখন আসবে আল্লাহর সাহায্য ও (ইসলামের চূড়ান্ত) বিজয়,
ayahs.translation_en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
ayahs.conventional_en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
ayahs.meta_bn: সিস্টেম বুস্টিং ও ব্লক আনলকিং প্রটোকল
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ص-ر (n-ṣ-r): divine assistance; ف-ت-ح (f-t-ḥ): opening of hearts, cities, and cognitive horizons.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যখন আসবে আল্লাহর সাহায্য ও (ইসলামের চূড়ান্ত) বিজয়,

english_translations.sahih_international: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
english_translations.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
english_translations.shakir: When there comes the help of Allah and the victory,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), when help and victory comes from God,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: When comes the Help of Allah (to you, O Muhammad (Peace be upon him) against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah),
english_translations.arberry: When comes the help of God, and victory,

ayahs.transliteration: wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan
ayahs.translation_bn: আর তুমি মানুষদের দেখবে দলে দলে আল্লাহর দীনে প্রবেশ করতে,
ayahs.translation_en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
ayahs.conventional_en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-و-ج (f-w-j): mass convergence of nations embracing universal monotheism.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তুমি মানুষদের দেখবে দলে দলে আল্লাহর দীনে প্রবেশ করতে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-و-ج (f-w-j): mass convergence of nations embracing universal monotheism.

english_translations.sahih_international: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
english_translations.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
english_translations.shakir: And you see men entering the religion of Allah in companies,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: you will see large groups of people embracing the religion of God.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And you see that the people enter Allah's religion (Islam) in crowds,
english_translations.arberry: and thou seest men entering God's religion in throngs,

ayahs.transliteration: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban
ayahs.translation_bn: তখন তুমি (শুকরিয়া আদায়ের উদ্দেশ্যে) তোমার প্রতিপালকের প্রশংসা সহকারে তাঁর পবিত্রতা ও মহিমা ঘোষণা করবে আর তাঁর কাছে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করবে। তিনি বড়ই তাওবা কবূলকারী।

words.translation_bn: এবং তাঁর কাছে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করো।

ayahs.translation_en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root س-ب-ح (s-b-ḥ): glorification of transcendent order; ত-و-ب (t-w-b): divine restoration of moral homeostasis.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তখন তুমি (শুকরিয়া আদায়ের উদ্দেশ্যে) তোমার প্রতিপালকের প্রশংসা সহকারে তাঁর পবিত্রতা ও মহিমা ঘোষণা করবে আর তাঁর কাছে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করবে। তিনি বড়ই তাওবা কবূলকারী।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root س-ب-ح (s-b-ḥ): glorification of transcendent order; ত-و-ب (t-w-b): divine restoration of moral homeostasis.

english_translations.sahih_international: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
english_translations.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
english_translations.shakir: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness; surely He is oft-returning (to mercy).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Glorify your Lord with praise and ask Him for forgivenes. He accepts repentance.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask for His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.
english_translations.arberry: then proclaim the praise of thy Lord, and seek His forgiveness; for He turns again unto men.
